why: 25:29-54:02 (~29 of 62 min) teaches the new pair كسر/انكسر in past, present, command and sentences (Medi works the steps out from the earlier verbs, 25:45 'You're gonna explain to me the next verb'; 27:54 'بكسر. I break'; 36:11 'هلأ شو بدنا نعمل للفعل اللي بعده؟' -> بنكسر); mixed with ~12 min of زعج/انزعج review and homework sentences (13:04 'شو بتتذكر من آخر درس؟' to 25:25), 01:42-13:00 small talk (wedding, kebab, fixing the air conditioning, clothes) plus 03:38-05:51 English talk about the recording system, and 54:37-57:25 a recap of the in- verbs (بسط/انبسط, زعج/انزعج, كسر/انكسر). 57:37-1:01:39 Amal offers the last causative verbs (get hungry/full/cold/hot); Medi keeps only خرب/خرّب, which she previews (1:00:51) and teaches on 09-11; 'No more causative verbs. بكفي' (1:01:39). 42:15-42:29 Medi briefly talks to a passer-by.
